description: Handoff from supera-engineer to the orchestrator. One receipt per implementation run.

filesChanged.description: Paths of files modified, created, or deleted, relative to repo root. May be empty for pure deletion tasks — use receipt.notes to explain.

notes.description: Optional: warnings, caveats, or context for the orchestrator. Use to flag 'no test infrastructure', 'no lint config', or any deviation from the standard process.

summary.description: One-line description of what was implemented.

verification.description: Verification output per layer. Keys: 'build', 'lint', plus one per detected test layer (e.g., unit, integration, e2e). No other keys. Values: pass, fail, skipped.

title: supera-engineer receipt
